subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Why Scandals Keep Happening
description: Learn Why Scandals Keep Happening in one minute.

hook.text: The same types of breaches happen year after year. Weak passwords, unpatched systems, and insider threats.

buildup.text: Companies collect maximum data with minimum security. The incentives favor collection over protection.

discovery.text: Security spending averages 5-10% of IT budgets. Marketing and data collection get far more resources.

twist.text: Companies face no real consequences for over-collecting. They only get punished when they lose it.

climax.text: Until collecting less data becomes more profitable than collecting more, privacy scandals will repeat.

quiz.question: Why do privacy breaches continue to happen despite past scandals?
options: Companies prioritize data collection over security investment
Hacking technology advances faster than all defenses
Users refuse to use strong passwords
